capabilities: Insert citations through Zotero's native picker with page/paragraph locators
Render footnote markers as superscript numbers with hover preview and in-place locator editing
Switch CSL styles and citation modes (footnote, endnote, in-text) across a document
Generate a formatted bibliography from citations in the document
Export .docx via Pandoc with live ZOTERO_ITEM citation fields
extras: Desktop-only (isDesktopOnly: true) and requires Obsidian 1.5.7+; developed and tested primarily on macOS, with Linux and Windows not yet fully validated. Communicates only with Zotero/Better BibTeX over local loopback (default port 23119); no account, payments, ads, or telemetry. Unlink citations is irreversible, and hidden <!-- zotero:ITEMKEY --> metadata must not be removed manually.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in support for Zotero-backed citations with native picker, Zotero CSL styling, Word-style footnote display, or Word export that keeps citations as live fields.

relations.evidence: Better BibTeX | Zotero plugin that provides the API layer
Uses Pandoc and a bundled Better BibTeX Lua filter to create .docx files

summary: Zotero citation manager that inserts and styles citations via Zotero and Better BibTeX, and exports Word documents with live citation fields using Pandoc.
